--- page 1 ---
MCU_XYZ Microcontroller Datasheet (Sample/Synthetic, for testing only)

## General Description

MCU_XYZ is a 32-bit microcontroller in a QFN-32 5x5mm package, used here
as component U3. It provides an SPI peripheral with a maximum clock rate
of 50 MHz.

--- page 2 ---
## Pin Description

Pad 1: VCC (supply, 3.3V nominal, 3.0-3.6V absolute range)
Pad 2: GND (ground reference)
Pad 4: SPI_CLK (SPI clock output, push-pull, max 50 MHz)

## Electrical Characteristics

Recommended PCB clearance around SPI_CLK and other high-speed digital pads
is at least the board's standard clearance class; reduced clearance near
the SPI_CLK pad increases coupling to adjacent nets and can cause clock
edge distortion at frequencies above 20 MHz.

--- page 3 ---
## Layout Recommendations

Keep SPI_CLK trace width consistent with the qualified stackup impedance
target. Avoid necking down the SPI_CLK trace near component pads, as
narrow segments increase series resistance and can shift rise/fall times
enough to violate SPI timing margins at the maximum rated clock speed.
